items.note: The prompt never brings up the July Pro price increase from 49 to 69 USD or asks whether it drove Pro churn.
The prompt doesn't say to exclude trial accounts (is_trial = yes).
The prompt doesn't say to exclude internal test accounts with emails ending in @ourco.test.
The prompt doesn't define churn as an account having a cancel_month.
